placements.why: All three segments are Sprint 4 delivery evidence for the anti-Slack thesis: the async decision widget shipped (src-1), velocity peaked at 23 points (src-2), and the Zephyr integration unlocked cross-platform capture (src-3). Together they demonstrate that structured async decisions produce persistent artifacts — the core anti-Slack claim.

The shipped widget (src-1) is the mechanism that captures decisions at the moment of consensus, and the Zephyr integration (src-3) is the technical unlock that lets that capture happen across chat platforms without separate plugins — directly extending the decision-capture-at-consensus narrative.
